claims2022dec.clause: Amendment 3(a), 6; Schedule I row 14 and Note 1

indexCheck.scope: Targeted index and original-provision review; not exhaustive current-law certification.

findings.title: Original location corrected
findings.detail: The 2016 original notification places the conflicting high-fibre range in FPSFA 2.11.8 itself. The 2022 original Claims amendment replaces Schedule I and confirms six source/high thresholds, including a separate liquid basis. No express deletion or reconciliation of the dextrin proviso was established in this scoped review.

findings.title: Six thresholds confirmed
findings.detail: Source: 3 g/100 g solids, 1.5 g/100 ml liquids or 1.5 g/100 kcal. High/rich: 6, 3 or 3 on the same respective bases. These are alternative minimums, not maximums or a serving-size route.

findings.title: Amendment scope checked
findings.detail: The 2020 amendment addresses oils and protein claim labels; August 2022 replaces the edible-oil schedule. December 2022 replaces Schedules I–III. The July 2023 direction extends only regulation 4(7), not fibre thresholds.

findings.title: Arithmetic does not approve a claim
findings.detail: Use validated finished-food fibre data with an explicit basis. Other claim conditions, special-category provisions and the dextrin conflict remain separate. Health-supplement categories are referred to their own regulations by Schedule I Note 1.
